name: G7 T3 W12 Part 2 - Demonstrate your warning system
description: Demonstrate your warning system. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A part that detects a change, such as light or distance.
words.example: The sensor measures the light around the micro:bit.

words.definition: The value where a program changes its response.
words.example: The threshold is 100, so a reading of 99 is below it.
